_comment: DISCOVERY probe: select a Counties study area, then for a spread of indicator groups read the Geography (reporting-level) dropdown options. level is deliberately a no-match sentinel so harvest.js logs 'available: <real level labels>' (harvest.js:241) for every indicator without doing a slow grid harvest.
